instruction: Write a ServiceAccount for a pod named 'app-sa' in default namespace.
output:
apiVersion: v1
kind: ServiceAccount
metadata:
  name: app-sa
  namespace: default

instruction: Write a Role allowing get, list, watch on pods in namespace default.
output:
apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
kind: Role
metadata:
  namespace: default
  name: pod-reader
rules:
- apiGroups: [""]
  resources: ["pods"]
  verbs: ["get", "list", "watch"]

instruction: Write a RoleBinding binding Role pod-reader to ServiceAccount app-sa.

- kind: ServiceAccount

  apiGroup: rbac.authorization.k8s.io

instruction: Write a ServiceAccount used by a CI/CD pipeline with namespace-scoped permissions.
output:
apiVersion: v1
kind: ServiceAccount
metadata:
  name: cicd-sa
  namespace: cicd
---
apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
kind: Role
metadata:
  namespace: cicd
  name: cicd-role
rules:
- apiGroups: ["apps"]
  resources: ["deployments"]
  verbs: ["get", "list", "create", "update", "patch"]
- apiGroups: [""]
  resources: ["pods", "services"]
  verbs: ["get", "list"]
---
apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
kind: RoleBinding
metadata:
  name: cicd-binding
  namespace: cicd
subjects:
- kind: ServiceAccount
  name: cicd-sa
  namespace: cicd
roleRef:
  kind: Role
  name: cicd-role
  apiGroup: rbac.authorization.k8s.io

instruction: Write a ServiceAccount for a monitoring agent with cluster-level read access.
output:
apiVersion: v1
kind: ServiceAccount
metadata:
  name: monitoring-sa
  namespace: monitoring
---
apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
kind: ClusterRole
metadata:
  name: monitoring-read
rules:
- apiGroups: [""]
  resources: ["pods", "nodes", "services", "endpoints"]
  verbs: ["get", "list", "watch"]
- apiGroups: ["apps"]
  resources: ["deployments", "statefulsets", "daemonsets"]
  verbs: ["get", "list", "watch"]
---
apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
kind: ClusterRoleBinding
metadata:
  name: monitoring-binding
subjects:
- kind: ServiceAccount
  name: monitoring-sa
  namespace: monitoring
roleRef:
  kind: ClusterRole
  name: monitoring-read
  apiGroup: rbac.authorization.k8s.io
